English: We aimed to examine mortality in patients with tuberculosis from high-burden countries, according to concordance or discordance of results from drug susceptibility testing done locally and whole-genome sequencing (WGS).
Luganda: Twagenderera okwekaliriza okufa kw’abalwadde abalina endwadde y’akafuba okuva mu mawanga agalina omuwendo omunene ogw’abantu abalina endwadde eno, okusinziira ku kukkaanya oba obutakkaanya na byava mu kukebera abalwadde oba nga balina akafuba akagugubira eddagala okwakolebwa munda mu ggwanga awamu n’ensengeka y’endagabutonde zonna (WGS).
Yoruba: A fọkàn sí láti wo ikú àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ikọ́ ife ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí wọ́n ní bùkátà púpọ̀, tí ó wà ní ìbámu tàbí tí kò sí ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú èsì ìdánwò ohun ògùn náà lè gbà mọ́ra tí wọ́n ṣe ní àwọn àgbègbè tí ìdàgbàsókè ò tíì bá dáadáa àti ìṣàgbéyẹ̀wò jínọ́ọ̀mù lódindi (WGS).
Zulu: Sasihlose ukuhlola ukufa ezigulini ezinesifo sofuba ezivela emazweni anomthwalo omkhulu, ngokuya ngokuvumelana noma ukungafani kwemiphumela evela ekuhlolweni kokuthambekela kwezidakamizwa okwenziwa endaweni kanye nokulandelana kocwaningofuzo lonkana (WGS).
Hausa: Mun yi nufin bincika yawan mace-mace a cikin marasa lafiya masu fama da tarin fuka daga ƙasashe masu nauyi, bisa ga yarda ko rashin jituwa na sakamakon gwajin kamuwa da magani da aka yi a cikin gida da kuma jerin ƙwayoyin gado (WGS).
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra ikemišetša go lekola mahu go balwetši bao ba nago le TB go tšwa ka dinageng tšeo di amilwego kudu, go ya ka nepagalo goba go se nepagale ga dipoelo tša diteko tša mabapi le go angwa ke dihlare ka tatelanyo ya botlalo le yaditšini ka botlalo (WGS).
Amharic: በሃገር ውስጥ እና በሙሉ ጂኖም ቅደም ተከተል (ሙ.ጂ.ቅ) ከተደረጉ የመድሃኒት የተጋላጭነት ምርመራ ውጤቶች በመስማማት እና ባለመስማማት ላይ በመመስረት፣ ከፍተኛ ጫና ካለባቸው ሃገሮች የሚመጡ የሳንባ ነቀርሳ በሽተኞችን ሟችነት ለመመርመር አልመን ነበር።

English: In this multicentre cohort study, we collected pulmonary Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates and clinical data from individuals with tuberculosis from antiretroviral therapy programmes and tuberculosis clinics in Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, Peru, South Africa, and Thailand, stratified by HIV status and drug resistance.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno okwakolebwa mu bifo ebijjanjabirwamu eby’enjawulo ku bantu ab’ekibinja ekimu, twakuŋŋaanya obuwuka obuleeta akafuba k’omu mawuggwe n’obubaka okuva mu bantu abalina akafuba okuva mu nteekateeka z’okulwanyisa obulwadde bwa mukeenenya n’obulwaliro obujjanjaba akafuba mu ggwanga lya Côte d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, Peru, South Africa, ne Thailand, nga bwawuddwamu okusinziira ku mbeera omuntu gy’alimu bwe kituuka ku kawuka ka HIV awamu n’obugugubi bw’eddagala.
Yoruba: Nínú ọ̀wọ́ ìwádìí onírúurú yìí, a gba ẹ̀dà àwọn kòkòrò tí wọ́n ń fa ikọ́ ife láti ẹ̀dọ̀fóró àti ìtọ́jú dátà láti ọ̀dọ àwọn ẹni tó ní àìsan ikọ́ ife láti èto Ìtọ́jú lọ́wọ́ Fáírọ́sì-Àǹtìrítíró àti ìmójútó àìsan ikọ́ ife ní Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, Peru, South Africa, àti Thailand, ní wáwà nípele pẹ̀lú ipò HIV àti Agbára-ìdojúkọ Oògùn.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo lweqembu elixubile, siqoqe igciwane lsesifo sofuba samaphaphu kanye nengcobelelo yomtholampilo kubantu abanesifo sofuba ezinhlelweni zokwelapha ngezidambisigciwane kanye nemitholampilo yesifo sofuba e-Côte d'Ivoire, Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, Peru, Ningizimu Africa, naseThailand, ihlukaniswe ngesimo se-HIV kanye nokungazweli emishanguzweni.
Hausa: A cikin wannan nazarin rukunonin jama’a da yawa, mun tattara keɓewar cutar tarin fuka na Mycobacterium na huhu da bayanan asibiti daga mutanen da suke ɗauke da tarin fuka daga shirye-shiryen maganin cutar ƙanjamau da asibitocin tarin fuka a Cote d'Ivoire, Jamhuriyar Demokraɗiyyar Kongo da Kenya da Nijeriya da Peru da Afirka ta Kudu, da kuma Thailand, rarrabuwa ta yanayin HIV da juriya na magani.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše tša mafelong a mantši ka ga batho ba bolwetši bja go swana, re kgobokeditše dihlathi tša TB ya maswafo ya legoro la Mycobacterium le Tshedimošo ka ga kalafo go tšwa go batho bao ba nago le TB go tšwa ka mananeong a kalafo ya twantšho ya dibaerase le ka dikluiniking tša go alafa TB ka Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria, Peru, South Africa, le Thailand, yeo e mpefatšwago ke maemo a HIV le go palelwa ka diokobatši.
Amharic: በዚህ የብዝሃ ማዕከል ስብስብ ጥናት በኮትዲቯር፣ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ፣ ኬኒያ፣ ናይጄሪያ፣ ፔሩ፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ታይላንድ ከሚገኙ የጸረ-ኤችአይቪ ህክምና ፕሮግራሞች እና የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ክሊኒኮች በኤችአይቪ ሁኔታ እና በመድሃኒት ተጋተሮ ረገድ ከተከፋፈሉ እና ሳንባ ነቀርሳ ካለባቸው ግለሰቦች የፕሉመናሪ ማይኮባክቴሪየም የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ልይቶችን እና የክሊኒክ መረጃዎችን ሰብስበናል።

English: We included individuals aged 16 years or older with pulmonary tuberculosis (bacteriologically confirmed or clinically diagnosed).

Yoruba: A ṣàfíkún àwọn èèyàn tí wọ́n ti pé ọmọ ọdún 16 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ tí wọ́n ní àrùn ikọ́ ife tí ó ní ṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀yà ara tí ó ń gbé èémí jáde (tí àrídájú àrùn náà wà tàbí tí wọ́n rí nínú èsì ìdánwò ajẹ́mọ́wòsàn).

Northern Sotho: Re akareditše batho ba mengwaga ye 16 goba go feta bao ba nago le TB ya maswafo (yeo e tiišeleditšwego gore e na le dipaktheria goba ye e phekotšwego ka tša kalafo).
Amharic: እድሜያቸው 16 ወይም ከዚያ በላይ የሆኑ የፕሉመናሪ ሳንባ ነቀርሳ (በስነ-ባክቴሪያ ረገድ የተረጋገጠ እና በክሊኒክ የተመረመረ) ያለባቸውን አካተናል።

English: We analysed mortality in multivariable logistic regression models adjusted for sex, age, HIV status, history of tuberculosis, and sputum positivity.
Luganda: Twekaliriza okufa kw’abantu mu mutetenkanyirizo gw’enkolagana wakati w’ebireetezi n’ebivaamu ogwakyusibwamu ne guba nga gusobola okukwata obubaka obufa ku kikula, emyaka, embeera y’omuntu bwe kituuka ku kawuka ka HIV, ebyafaayo by’akawuka, n’ekikolondolwa ekikakasa okubaawo kw’endwadde.
Yoruba: A ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò ikú nínú àwọn módẹ́ẹ̀lì onífàsẹ́yìn tí ó ní oríṣiríṣi ọ̀nà tí wọ́n tún ètò rẹ̀ ṣe ní ìbámu fún bóyá ọkùnrin tàbí obìnrin, ọjọ́ orí, bóyá ó ní HIV tàbí kò ní, bóyá ó ní ìtàn ikọ́ ife, àti kẹ̀lẹ̀bẹ̀ tó ń tinú ẹ̀dọ̀fóró jáde.
Zulu: Sihlaziye ukufa kwabantu ngamamodeli erigesheni aguquguqukayo alungiselelwe ubulili, ubudala, isimo se-HIV, umlando wesifo sofuba, kanye nokuba khona kwesikhwehlela.
Hausa: Mun yi nazarin yawan mace-mace a cikin samfurorin koma baya waɗanda aka daidaita domin jinsi da shekaru da matsayin HIV da tarihin tarin fuka, da ƙimar sputum.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra sekaseka mahu ka go mekgwa ya poelomorago ya kamantšho ya pharologanyo ye ntši yeo e beakanyeditšwe tša thobalano, mengwaga, maemo a HIV, histori ya TB, le go hwetšagala ka gare ga mare.
Amharic: በጾታ፣ በዕድሜ፣ በኤችአይቪ ሁኔታ፣ በሳንባ ነቀርሳ ታሪክ እና በአክታ አዎንታዊነት በተስተካከሉ በብዙ ተለዋዋጭ ሎጂስቲክ አማካይ ተዛምዶ ሞዴሎች ውስጥ ሟችነትን ተንትነናል።

English: Between Sept 1, 2014, and July 4, 2016, of 634 patients included in our previous analysis, we included 582 patients with tuberculosis (median age 33 years [IQR 27–43], 225 [39%] women, and 247 [42%] HIV-positive).
Luganda: Wakati w’Ogwomwenda 1, 2014 n’Ogwomusanvu 4, 2016, mu balwadde 634 abaakozesebwa mu kwekaliriza kwaffe okw’emabega, twakozesa abalwadde 582 abalina akafuba (ng’omukkati gw’emyaka gyabwe guli ku myaka 33 [IQR 27–43], 225 [39%] abakyala, ne 247 [42%] abalina HIV).
Yoruba: Ìwádìí tí ó wáyé Láàárín 1 oṣù Ọ̀wẹ̀wẹ̀, 2014 àti 4, òṣù Agẹmọ 2016, tí aláìsàn 634 tí a ṣàfíkún sí àgbéyẹ̀wò wa ti tẹ́lẹ̀, a ṣàfíkún aláìsàn 582 tí wọ́n ní ikọ́ ife (ọjọ́ orí tí ó wà ní àárín wọn ní ọmọ ọdún 33 [IQR 27–43], 225 [39%] obìnrin, àti 247 [42%] àwọn tí wọ́n ní HIV).
Zulu: Okutholakele Phakathi kuka-Mand.1, 2014, no-Ntulikazi 4, 2016, ama-634 eziguli ezifakwe ekuhlaziyweni kwethu kwangaphambili, sahlanganisa iziguli ze-582 ezinesifo sofuba (iminyaka ephakathi kweminyaka enga-33 [IQR 27-43], 225 [39%] abesifazane, kanye nama-247 [42%] abane-HIV).
Hausa: Sakamako Tsakanin watan Satumba 1, shekara ta 2014, da Yuli 4, shekara ta 2016, na marasa lafiya guda 634 da aka haɗa a cikin bincikenmu na baya, mun haɗa da marasa lafiya guda 582 masu tarin fuka (tsakiyar shekaru, shekaru 33 [IQR 27-43], 225 [39%)] mata, da kuma 247 [42%] masu ɗauke da cutar HIV).
Northern Sotho: Magareng ga Sept 1, 2014, le Julae 4, 2016, go balwetši ba 634 bao ba akareditšwego ka go tshekatsheko ya rena ye e fetilego, re tsentše balwetši ba 582 bap ba bego ba na le TB (ba mengwaga ya magareng ye 33 [IQR 27–43], 225 [39%] e le basadi, gomme ba 247 [42%] ba na le HIV).
Amharic: በሴፕቴምበር 1፣ 2014 እና ጁላይ 4፣ 2016 መካከል በቀድሞው ትንታኔ ውስጥ ከተካተቱት 634 ታማሚዎች 582 የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ታማሚዎችን (መካከለኛ ዕድሜ 33 ዓመት [IQR 27–43]፣ 225 [39%] ሴቶች እና 247 [42%] ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸውን) አካተናል።

English: Based on WGS, 339 (58%) isolates were pan-susceptible, 35 (6%) monoresistant, 146 (25%) multidrug-resistant, and 24 (4%) pre-extensively drug-resistant (pre-XDR) or XDR.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku nkola ya WGS, abalwadde 339 (58%) abaawuddwa mu bantu abalala baali basobola okukosebwa eddagala, 35 (6%) nga bagugubira eddagala lya kika kimu, 146 (25%) bagugubira eddagala ery’ebika ebiwera, olwo nga 24 (4%) nga boolekedde okutuuka ku ddaala ery’obugugubi bw’eddagala obwa waggulu ddala (pre-XDR) oba XDR.
Yoruba: Lórí ìpìlẹ̀ WGS, 339 (58%) ẹ̀dà ni wọ́n lè gba àwọn oríṣiríṣi àrùn míràn mọ́ra, 35 (6%)alátakò ohun kan, 146 (25%) alátakò ògùn púpọ̀, àti 24 (4%) alátakò ògùn ṣíwájú ọlọ́jọ gbọọrọ (pre XDR) tàbí XDR.
Zulu: Ngokusekelwe ku-WGS, ama-339 (58%) ababekwe eceleni ayengazweli epanini, angama-35 (6%) amelana nezidakamizwa, ayi-146 (25%) amelana nezidakamizwa eziningi, kanye nama-24 (4%) amelana nezidakamizwa (pre-XDR) noma i-XDR .
Hausa: Dangane da WGS, keɓewar 339 (58%) sun kasance mara juriya, 35 (6%) masu jure wa magani ɗaya, 146 (25%) masu jure magunguna da yawa, da 24 (4%) fara jure wa magani (pre-XDR) ko XDR .
Northern Sotho: Go ya ka WGS, ba 339 (58%) bao ba arotšwego ba be ba na le go palelwa ga dihlare ka moka, ba 35 (6%) mba be ba paella sehlare se tee, ba 146 (25%) ba paella dihlare tše ntši, ba 24 (4%) ba be ba paella dihlare le peleng (pre-XDR) goba XDR.
Amharic: በሙ.ጂ.ቅ ላይ በመመስረት 339 (58%) ልይቶች ለብዙ-የተለያዩ-ተጋለጭ፣ 35 (6%) ለአንድ-ውስን-ተቋቋሚ፣ 146 (25%) ለብዙ-መድሃኒት-ተቋቋሚ እና 24 (4%) ቅድመ-በሰፊው-መድሃኒት-ተቋቋሚ (ቅድመ-በሰ.መ.ተ) ወይም በሰ.መ.ተ ነበሩ።

English: The analysis of mortality was based on 530 patients; 63 (12%) died and 77 (15%) patients received inappropriate treatment.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza okufa kw’abantu kwesigamizibwa ku balwadde 530; 63 (12%) baafa ate 77 (15%) baaweebwa eddagala likyamu.
Yoruba: Àgbéyẹ̀wò lórí ikú yìí pin lẹ̀ lórí àwọn aláìsàn 530; 63 (12%) ló kú àti 77 (15%) aláìsàn ló gba ìtọ́jú tí kò yẹ.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kokushona kwakusekelwe ezigulini ezingama-530; Ama-63 (12%) ashona kwathi iziguli ezingama-77 (15%) zathola ukwelashwa okungafanele.
Hausa: Nazarin yawan mace-mace ya dogara ne a kan marasa lafiya guda 530; guda 63 (12%) da suka mutu kuma 77 (15%) na marasa lafiya sun sami maganin da bai dace ba.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya mahu e be e theilwe go balwetši ba 530; ba 63 (12%) ba ile ba hlokofala gomme balwetši ba 77 (15%) ba hweditše kalafo ye e sego ya maleba.
Amharic: የሟችነት ትንተና በ530 ታማሚዎች ላይ የተመሰረተ ነበር፤ 63 (12%) ሲሞቱ 77 (15%) ደግሞ ተገቢ ያልሆነ ህክምና አግኝተው ነበር።

English: Mortality ranged from 6% (18 of 310) in patients with pan-susceptible tuberculosis to 39% (nine of 23) in patients with pre-XDR or XDR tuberculosis.
Luganda: Okufa kw’abantu kwava ku bitundu 6% (18 ku 310) mu balwadde abasobola okukwatibwa akafuba okutuuka ku bitundu 39% (mwenda ku 23) mu balwadde abalina akafuba ak’ekika kya pre-XDR oba XDR.
Yoruba: Ikú láàárín àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ikọ́ ife tí ó tún máa ń gba oríṣiríṣi àrùn míràn mọ́ra bẹ̀rẹ̀ láti 6% (18 lára 310) sí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ikọ́ ife pre-XDR tàbí XDR tí wọ́n jẹ́ 39% (mẹ́sàn-án lára 23).
Zulu: Ukufa kwakusukela ema-6% (18 ka-310) ezigulini ezine-sifo sofuba esimelana nezidakamizwa kuya ku-39% (ayisishiyagalolunye kwanga-23) ezigulini ezine-pre-XDR noma i-XDR tuberculosis.
Hausa: Yawan mace-mace ya kama daga kashi 6% (18 cikin 310) a cikin marasa lafiya da tarin fuka mara juriya zuwa kashi 39% (tara cikin 23) a cikin marasa lafiya da cutar ta pre-XDR ko tarin fuka na XDR.
Northern Sotho: Mahu ra be a farologane go thoma go 6% (18 of 310) go balwetši bao ba bego ba paella dihlare ka moka go fihla go 39% (ba senyane go ba 23) go balwetši bao ba bego ba na le TB ya pre-XDR goba XDR tuberculosis.
Amharic: ሟችነት ከ6% (18 ከ310) የብዙ-የተለያዩ-ተጋላጭ ሳንባ ነቀርሳ ያለባቸው ታማሚዎች እስከ 39% (ዘጠኝ ከ23) የቅድመ-ሰ.መ.ተ ወይም የሰ.መ.ተ ሳንባ ነቀርሳ ያለባቸው ታማሚዎች ይደርሳል።

English: The adjusted odds ratio for mortality was 4·92 (95% CI 2·47–9·78) among undertreated patients, compared with appropriately treated patients.
Luganda: Emigabanyo gy’okufa kw’abantu gyali ku 4·92 (95% CI 2·47–9·78) mu balwadde abajjanjabibwa ekitono, bw’ogeraageranya n’abalwadde abajjanjabibwa obulungi.
Yoruba: Ìṣirò àwọn ìpín tí wọ́n ṣàtúnṣe rẹ̀ lórí ikú jẹ́ 4·92 (95% CI 2·47–9·78) láàárín àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn kò tọ́jú dáadáa, sí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n rí ìtọ́jú tó péye.
Zulu: Isilinganiso sezinkinga ezilungisiwe zokufa kwaba zi-4 · 92 (95% CI 2 · 47-9 · 78) phakathi kweziguli ezingaphathwa kahle, uma kuqhathaniswa neziguli eziphathwa ngendlela efanele.
Hausa: Matsakaicin daidaitawar rashin daidaituwa don mace-mace shi ne 4·92 (95% CI 2·47–9·78) a tsakanin marasa lafiya da ba a kula da su sosai ba, idan aka kwatanta da marasa lafiya da suka samu kulawa yadda ya dace.
Northern Sotho: Kelo ya bona ya go se tlwaelege ye e fetošitšwego ya mahu e bile 4·92 (95% CI 2·47–9·78) gareng ga balwetši bao ba bego ba sa hwetše kalafo gabotse, ge go bapetšwa le balwetši bao ba bego ba alafa ka maleba.
Amharic: ለሟችነት የተስተካከለው አንፃራዊ ይሆንታ ውድር በአግባቡ ህክምና ከተደረገላቸው ታማሚዎች ጋር ሲነጻጸር በበቂ ሁኔታ ህክምና ካልተደረገላቸው ታማሚዎች መካከል 4.92 (95% አ.ክ 2.47 – 9.78) ነበር።

English: In seven countries with a high burden of tuberculosis, we observed discrepancies between drug resistance patterns obtained locally and WGS.
Luganda: Mu mawanga musanvu agalina omuwendo omunene ogw’abantu abalina akafuba, twazuula enjawulo wakati w’obugugubi bw’eddagala obwafunibwa munda mu ggwanga n’obwo obwa WGS.
Yoruba: Nínú àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè méje tí wọ́n ní àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ikọ́ ife púpọ̀, a ri pé kò sí ìbáṣepọ̀ láàárín bí àìfàyègba ìṣiṣẹ́ oògùn ṣe ń wáyé láàárín èyí tí a gbà ní àwọn àgbègbè tí ìdàgbàsókè kò tíì dé bá dáadáa àti WGS.
Zulu: Emazweni ayisikhombisa anomthwalo omkhulu wesifo sofuba, sibone ukungqubuzana phakathi kwamaphethini okumelana nemithi atholakala endaweni kanye ne-WGS.
Hausa: Fassara A cikin ƙasashe bakwai masu tarin fuka da yawa, mun lura da bambance-bambance a tsakanin tsarin juriya na magani da aka samu a gida da kuma WGS.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tše šupa tšeo di nago le phetetšo ye kgolo kudu ya TB, re ile ra itemogela go se sepelelane magareng ga mekgwa ya go paella dihlare tšeo di hweditšwego ka nageng le WGS.
Amharic: በሃገር ውስጥ በተገኙ የመድሃኒት ተጋትሮ ቅጦች እና ሙ.ጂ.ቅ መካከል ልዩነቶችን የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ከፍተኛ ጫና ባለባቸው ሰባት ሃገሮች ውስጥ ተመልክተናል።

English: The underdiagnosis of drug resistance resulted in inappropriate treatment and higher mortality.
Luganda: Okukebera ekitono ku bugugubi bw’eddagala bwaviirako enzijanjaba embi n’abantu okufa ennyo.
Yoruba: Ìdánwò abẹ́lẹ̀ fún àìfàyègba ìṣiṣẹ́ oògùn ló bí ìṣewòsàn tí kò dára tó àti bí ìwọ̀n ikú ṣe ga tó.
Zulu: Ukuxilongwa ngaphansi kokumelana nezidakamizwa kubangele ukwelashwa okungafanele kanye nokufa okuphezulu.
Hausa: Rashin ganewar asali na juriya na magani ya haifar da magani mara dacewa da kuma yawan mace-mace.
Northern Sotho: Go se phekole balwetši gabotse gore ba na le bolwetši bja go palela dihlare go feleleditše ka kalafo ye e sego maleba le mahu a mantši.
Amharic: የመድሃኒት ተጋትሮ በቂ ያልሆነ ምርመራ ተገቢ ያልሆነ ህክምናን እና ከፍተኛ ሞትን አስከትሏል።

English: WGS can provide accurate and detailed drug resistance information required to improve the outcomes of drug-resistant tuberculosis in high-burden settings.
Luganda: WGS esobola okuwa obubaka obutuukamu era obugazi obukwata ku bugugubi bw’eddagala owetaagibwa okutumbula ebiva kafuba akagugubira eddagala mu bifo ebirimu omuwendo omunene ogw’abantu abalina akafuba.
Yoruba: WGS lè pèsè àlàyé tó péye àti gún régé lórí àìfàyègba ìṣiṣẹ́ oògùn tí wọ́n nílò láti mú ìdàgbàsókè bá èsì lórí ikọ́ ife tí ń dojúkọ oògùn ní àwọn ibi tí bùkátà wọn ti pọ̀.
Zulu: I-WGS inganikeza ulwazi olunembile nolunemininingwane yokumelana nezidakamizwa oludingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela yesifo sofuba esingazweli ezidakamizweni ezindaweni ezinomthwalo omkhulu.
Hausa: WGS yana iya bayar da cikakkun bayanai dalla-dalla na juriya na magani da ake buƙata don haɓaka sakamakon cutar tarin fuka mai jure wa magani a cikin wurare masu nauyi mai girma .
Northern Sotho: WGS e kgona go fana ka tshedimošo ye e nepagetšego le ka botlalo mabapi le go palela ga dihlare yeo e nyakegago go kaonafatša TB ya go palela dihlare ka mafelong ao a nago le phetetšo ye ntši.
Amharic: በከፍተኛ ጫና መቸቶች ያሉ የመድሃኒት ተቋቋሚ ሳንባ ነቀርሳ ውጤቶችን ለማሻሻል የሚያስፈልግ የመድሃኒት ተጋትሮ ትክክለኛ እና ዝርዝር መረጃን ሙ.ጂ.ቅን ሊያቀርብ ይችላል።

English: Our results support WHO’s call for point-of-care tests based on WGS.
Luganda: Bye twazuula biwagira omulanga gw’ekitongole kya WHO ogw’okukola okukebera okwesigamye ku nkola ya WGS mu bifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsi wá ṣe ègbè fún ìpe WHO sí àyẹ̀wo ipò-onítọ̀ọ́jú tí ó gùnlé WGS.
Zulu: Imiphumela yethu isekela ikhwelo le-WHO lokuhlola ukunakekelwa okusekelwe ku-WGS.
Hausa: Sakamakonmu yana goyan bayan kiran da WHO ta yi don gwaje-gwajen kulawa bisa WGS.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša rena di thekga boipiletšo bja WHO bja gore go dirwe diteko mafelong a kalafo go theilwe go WGS.
Amharic: ውጤቶቻችን በWGS ላይ የተመሰረተውን የአለም ጤና ድርጅት የእንክብካቤ-ነጥብ-ምርመራዎች ጥሪን ይደግፋሉ።

English: Compared to alternatives, whole genome testing is a faster, more accurate and potentially life-saving way to find out whether specific types of medication used against the lung disease tuberculosis (TB) will help a particular patient.
Luganda: Bw’ogeraageranya n’ebirondebwako, okukebera endagabutonde okwawamu ngeri eyanguwa, ekola obulungi era etaasa obulamu mu kuzuula oba ng’eddagala ery’ebika eby’engeri emu ebirwanyisa akafuba (TB) bisobola okuyamba omulwadde omu.
Yoruba: Ní àfiwé pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀nà mìíràn, ìṣàyẹ̀wo àpo jíìnì yára, ṣe rẹ́gí àti pé ó ṣe é dóòlà ẹ̀mí láti ri pé oríṣi oògùn tí à ń lò sí àìsàn ikọ́ ife (TB) inú ọ̀fun yóò ṣe ìrànwọ́ nínú aláìsàn kan.
Zulu: Uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izindlela, ukuhlola i-genome yonke kuyindlela esheshayo, enemba kakhulu futhi engase isindise ukuphila ukuze uthole ukuthi izinhlobo ezithile zemithi esetshenziswa ngokumelene nesifo sofuba samaphaphu (TB) zizosiza yini isiguli esithile.
Hausa: Idan aka kwatanta da zaɓuɓɓuka, gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gadon gabaɗaya shi ne mafi sauri, mafi daidaito kuma hanya mai yiwuwar ceton rai domin gano ko takamaiman nau’o’in magungunan da ake amfani da su a kan cutar ta huhu na tarin fuka (TB) wanda za su taimaka wa wani majiyyaci.
Northern Sotho: Ge go bapetšwa le dikgetho tše dingwe, teko ya ditšini ka botlalo ke tsela ya ka pela, ye e nepagetšego kudu le yeo e kgonago go phološa maphelo go tseba ge eba mehuta ye itšego ya dihlare tše di šomišitšwego kgahjlanong le bolwetši bja mafahla(TB) e ka thuša molwetši yo a itšego.
Amharic: ከአማራጮች ጋር ሲነጻጸር፣ አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ ምርመራ ፈጣን፣ ለሳንባ ነቀርሳ የሳንባ በሽታ (ቲቢ) ጥቅም ላይ የሚውሉ የተወሰኑ የመድኃኒት ዓይነቶች ለአንድ የተለየ ታካሚ ይረዱ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ የሚያስችል የበለጠ ትክክለኛ እና ሕይወት-አድን መንገድ ነው።

English: Such tests must be available in countries with many TB patients.
Luganda: Okukebera okw’engeri eyo kulina okubeera mu mawanga agalina abalwadde ba TB abangi.
Yoruba: Irúfẹ́ àwọn àyẹ̀wò bẹ́ẹ̀ gbọdọ̀ jẹ́ wíwà lárọ̀ọ́wọ́tó ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tọ́ ní aláìsàn TB púpọ̀.
Zulu: Ukuhlola okunjalo kufanele kutholakale emazweni aneziguli eziningi ze-TB.
Hausa: Dole ne a sami irin waɗannan gwaje-gwaje a cikin ƙasashe masu yawan masu cutar TB.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tša mohuta woo di ka hwetšagala ka dinageng tšeo di nago le balwetši ba bantši ba TB.
Amharic: እንዲህ ዓይነት ምርመራዎች ብዙ የቲቢ ሕመምተኞች ባሉባቸው አገሮች ውስጥ መገኘት አለባቸው።

English: TB has become a treatable disease but drug-resistant tuberculosis is unfortunately becoming a worldwide problem making the control of the disease even more difficult than before.
Luganda: Akafuba bufuuse obulwadde obujjanjabika naye ebyembi akafuba akagumira eddagala kagenda kafuuka ekizibu ky’ensi yonna era nga kino kireetera enfuga y’obulwadde obwo okuba enzibu n’okusinga bwe kibadde emabega.
Yoruba: TB ti jẹ́ àìsàn tí a lè wò sàn ṣùgbọ́n ikọ́ ifẹ́ aláìgbóògùn ti ń gbìnà yá káàkiri àgbáyé léyìí tí í ń mú kí ìṣàkóso àìsàn náà léwu si ju ti àtẹ̀yìnwá lọ.
Zulu: I-TB isiyisifo eselaphekayo kodwa isifo sofuba esingazweli imishanguzo ngeshwa sesiyinkinga yomhlaba wonke okwenza ukulawula lesi sifo kube nzima kakhulu kunakuqala.
Hausa: TB ta zama cuta da za a iya magance ta, amma cutar tarin fuka mai jure wa magani abin takaici yana zama matsala a duniya da yake sa shawo kan cutar ya fi da wahala.
Northern Sotho: TB e fetogile bolwetši bja go alafega eupša TB ya go palela diokobatši ka maswabi e e fetogile bothata bja lefase ka bophara bjo bo dirago gore go laola bolwetši bjo go be boima le go feta le peleng.
Amharic: ቲቢ ሊታከም የሚችል በሽታ ሆኗል ነገር ግን በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ መድኃኒት-የተላመደው የሳንባ ነቀርሳ አለም አቀፍ ችግር እየሆነ በመምጣቱ የበሽታውን ቁጥጥር ከበፊቱ የበለጠ አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።

English: Drug-resistant tuberculosis occurs because some forms of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the bacteria that causes TB, have become resistant to many of the standard medicines that doctors normally prescribe to patients.
Luganda: Akafuba akagumira eddagala, kajja olw’okuba nti ebika ebimu ebya Mycobacterium tuberculosis, akawuka akaleeta TB, kagumira eddagala erisinga okukozesebwa era abasawo lye batera okuwa abalwadde.
Yoruba: Ikọ́ ife aláìgbóògùn máa ń jẹ jáde nítorí irú àwọn ikọ́ ife Mycobacterium, bakitéríà tí ń fa TB, ti ṣe ìdojúkọ sí àwọn ògùn tí àwọn dókítà máa ń kọ fún àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Isifo sofuba esingazweli emishanguzweni senzeka ngenxa yokuthi ezinye izinhlobo ze-Mycobacterium tuberculosis, amagciwane abangela i-TB, sezimelane nemithi eminingi evamile odokotela abavame ukuyinikeza iziguli.
Hausa: Cutar tarin fuka mai jure wa magani tana faruwa ne saboda wasu nau’o’in tarin fuka na Mycobacterium, ƙwayoyin cuta masu haifar da cutar TB, sun zama masu juriya ga yawancin magungunan da likitoci suka saba ba wa marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: TB ya go paella diokobatši e direga ka lebaka la mehuta ya TB ya Mycobacterium, e lego paktheria ye e bakago TB, e thomile go palela dihlare tše ntši tše di tlwaelegilego tšeo ka tlwaelo dingaka di di fago balwetši.
Amharic: መድኃኒት-የተላመደው የሳንባ ነቀርሳ የሚከሰተው አንዳንድ በሳንባ ነቀርሳ አምጪ ባክቴሪያ የሚመጡ የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ዓይነቶች፣ የቲቢ በሽታ መንስኤ የሆነው ባክቴሪያ፣ ዶክተሮች በተለምዶ ለታካሚዎች የሚያዙትን አብዛኛዎቹን መደበኛ መድሃኒቶች የመቋቋም አቅም ስላላቸው ነው።

English: This means that the bacteria have become too clever for the very medicines that were manufactured to kill it.
Luganda: Kino kitegeeza nti obuwuka obwo bufuuse bugezi nnyo okukamala eri eddagala eryakolebwa okubutta.
Yoruba: Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé bakitéríà náà ti gbọ́n ju ògùn tí à ń ṣe láti pa á lọ.
Zulu: Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi amagciwane asehlakaniphe kakhulu kuyona kanye imithi ekhiqiziwe ukuze ayibulale.
Hausa: Wannan yana nufin cewa ƙwayoyin cuta suna dabara da yawa ga magungunan da aka samar su kashe su.
Northern Sotho: Se se ra gore dipaktheria di thomile go ba bohlale kudu go dihlare tšeo di tšweleditšwego gore di di bolaye.
Amharic: ይህ ማለት ባክቴሪያው እሱን ለመግደል በተመረቱት መድሃኒቶች ላይ በጣም ጎበዝ ሆኗል ማለት ነው።

English: Unfortunately, it also means that these medicines no longer work for everybody.
Luganda: Ebyembi, era kitegeeza nti eddagala eryo terikyakolera buli muntu.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeni láàánú, ó tún túmọ̀ sí pé àwọn ògùn wọ̀nyí kò ṣiṣẹ́ fún gbogbo ènìyàn mọ́.
Zulu: Ngeshwa, kusho nokuthi le mithi ayisasebenzi kuwo wonke umuntu.
Hausa: Abin takaici, haka nan yana nufin cewa waɗannan magunguna ba sa aiki ga kowa.
Northern Sotho: Ka maswabi, se gape se ra gore dihlare tše ga di sa šomela motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe.
Amharic: እንደ አለመታደል ሆኖ፣ እነዚህ መድሃኒቶች ለሁሉም ሰው አይሰሩም ማለት ነው።

English: Before they can receive medication, TB patients must therefore be tested to find out whether they might have a form of drug-resistant tuberculosis, which would mean they need special medication.
Luganda: Awo nno, ng’abalwadde ba TB tebannaweebwa ddagala, balina okukeberebwa okuzuula oba nga bayinza okuba n’ekika ky’akafuba akagumira eddagala, ekitegeeza nti baba beetaaga obujjanjabi obw’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Kí wọ́n tó lè gba ògùn, àwọn aláìsàn TB gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe àyẹ̀wò bóyá wọ́n ní irúfẹ́ ikọ́ ife aláìgbóògùn, lèyí tó lè túmọ̀ sí pé wọ́n nílò ìtọ́jú alákànṣe.
Zulu: Ngaphambi kokuba bathole imithi, iziguli ze-TB kufanele zihlolwe ukuze kutholwe ukuthi zingase zibe nalo yini uhlobo lwesifo sofuba esingazweli emishanguzweni, okusho ukuthi zidinga imithi ekhethekile.
Hausa: Kafin masu cutar TB su sami magani, dole ne a gwada su domin don gano ko suna da nau’in tarin fuka mai jure wa magani, wanda hakan na nufin suna buƙatar magani na musamman.
Northern Sotho: Pele ga ge ba ka hwetša dihlare, balwetši ba TB ka fao ab swanetše go dirwa diteko go tseba ge eba ba ka ba le mohuta wa TB ya go palela dihlare, go rago gore ba ka be ba hloka šedi ye e kgethegilego.
Amharic: የቲቢ ህመምተኞች መድኃኒት ከመውሰዳቸው በፊት፣ መድኃኒት-የተላመደው የሳንባ ነቀርሳ አይነት ይኖራቸው እንደሆነ ለማወቅ መመርመር አለባቸው፣ ይህም ማለት ልዩ መድኃኒት ያስፈልጋቸዋል ማለት ነው።

English: One option is drug-susceptibility tests which can take weeks to perform and are not very accurate because they can only tell whether one or two types of the most common TB medicine will work for a patient or not.
Luganda: Ekimu ku biyinza okukolebwa kwe kukola okukebera kw’eddagala eritasobola kukola ku bulwadde erisobola okutwala wiiki ennyingi okukola ate nga terikolera bulungi nnyo kubanga baba basobola busobozi kugamba nti eddagala ery’omulundi ogumu oba ebiri erijjanjaba TB lisobola okukolera omulwadde oba nedda.
Yoruba: Ọ̀nà kan ni àyẹ̀wo ògun-abárùnagbègbèjà léyìí tó lè tó ọ̀sẹ̀ púpọ̀ láti ṣiṣẹ́ kì í sì í ṣe wẹ́kú tó nítorí wọ́n kán lè sọ bóyá oríṣi ògun TB kan àbí méjì yóò ṣiṣẹ́ fún aláìsàn kan tàbí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́.
Zulu: Enye indlela ukuhlola ukuthi uzosebenza yini umuthi okungathatha amasonto ukwenziwa futhi okunganembile kakhulu ngoba angakwazi ukubona kuphela ukuthi uhlobo olulodwa noma ezimbili zomuthi ovame kakhulu we-TB uzosisebenzela isiguli noma cha.
Hausa: Zaɓi ɗaya shi ne gwaje-gwajen karɓuwar magani waɗanda za su ɗauki makonni ana yin su kuma ba daidai ba ne saboda kawai za su iya faɗar ko nau’i ɗaya ko biyu na maganin TB na yau da kullum zai yi aiki ga majiyyaci ko a'a.
Northern Sotho: Kgetho e tee ke go dira diteko tša go palelwa ga diokobatši tšeo di ka tšeago dibeke go dirwa ebile ga se tša nepagala kudu ka ge di kgona go laetša fela ge eba mohuta o tee goba ye mebedi ya dihlare tša TB tše di tlwaelegilego di tla šoma go molwetši goba aowa.
Amharic: አንዱ አማራጭ ሳምንታት የሚፈጁት የመድኃኒት-ተጋላጭነት ምርመራዎች ናቸው እና በጣም ትክክል አይደሉም ምክንያቱም አንድ ወይም ሁለት በጣም የተለመዱ የቲቢ መድኃኒት አይነቶች ለታካሚ ይሰራሉ ወይም አይሰሩም የሚለውን ብቻ ማሳወቅ ይችላሉ።

English: Fewer “whole genome” testing works much better and can be done within days to find out whether around 19 types of TB medicines will work for a patient or not.
Luganda: Okukebera “kw’endagabutonde mu bulamba” okuggya kukola bulungi era kusobola okukolerwa mu nnaku ntono okuzuula oba nga eddagala ery’ebika nga 19 erijjanjaba TB lisobola okukolera omulwadde oba nedda.
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wo “Gbogbo àpo jíìnù” tuntun ń ṣiṣẹ́ dáradára ó sì lè di ṣíṣe láàárín ọjọ́ díẹ̀ láti ri bóyá irúfẹ́ ẹ̀ya oríṣi ògun TB 19 yóò ṣiṣẹ́ fún aláìsàn kan tàbí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́.
Zulu: Ukuhlola okusha “kwe-genome yonke” kusebenza kangcono kakhulu futhi kungenziwa ngezinsuku ukuthola ukuthi cishe izinhlobo eziyi-19 zemithi ye-TB zizosisebenzela isiguli noma cha.
Hausa: Sabon gwajin “ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado” ya fi aiki da kyau kuma ana iya yin sa cikin kwanaki don gano ko kusan nau’o’in magungunan cutar TB guda 19 wanda za su yi aiki ga majiyyaci ko a'a.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tše diswa tša “ditšini ka kakaretšo” di šoma bokaone kudu gomme di ka dirwa mo matšatšing a mmalwa go tseba ge eba mehuta ye 19 ya dihlare tša TB e tla šoma go molwetši goba aowa.
Amharic: አዲሱ የ"አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ" ምርመራ በተሻለ ሁኔታ ይሰራል እና ወደ 19 የሚጠጉት የቲቢ መድሃኒቶች ለታካሚው ይሰራሉ ወይም አይሰሩም የሚለውን ለማወቅ በቀናት ውስጥ ሊደረግ ይችላል።

English: It considers the genetic information contained in the whole of a patient’s DNA code, and not only parts of it.
Luganda: Okukukebera okwo kutunuulira obubaka bw’endagabutonde obuli mu koodi ya DNA ey’omulwadde, so si mu bitundu butundu.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe ìdàro àwọn ìròyin jẹ̀nẹ́tíìkì tó wà nínú àkójọ kóòdù DNA aláìsàn náà, láì í ṣe díẹ̀ lára ẹ̀.
Zulu: Ibheka imininingwane yofuzo equkethwe kuyo yonke ikhodi ye-DNA yesiguli, hhayi izingxenye zayo kuphela.
Hausa: Yana la'akari ne da bayanan ƙwayoyin gado da suke ƙunshe a cikin duka lambarar ƙwayar halittar DNA na majiyyaci, kuma ba kawai sassansa ba.
Northern Sotho: E hlokometše tshedimošo ya ditšini yeo e lego ka go khoute ya DNA ya molwetši, e sego dikarolo tša yona.
Amharic: በታካሚው የዲኤንኤ ኮድ ውስጥ የተወሰኑ ክፍሎችን ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ያለውን ሙሉ የዘረመል መረጃን ይመለከታል።

English: Researchers from across the world completed the study at a time when whole genome testing methods were not yet widely available in the countries that had the highest numbers of tuberculosis patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okuva mu nsi yonna baakola okunoonyereza kuno mu kiseera obukodyo bw’okukebera endagabutonde we bwali tebunnaba kubuna wonna mu mawanga agaalina abalwadde b’akafuba abasinga obungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí káàkiri àgbáyé parí ẹ̀kọ́ náà nígbà tí ìlàna àyẹ̀wo gbogbo àpo jíìnì náà kò tíì wà lárọ̀ọ́wọ́tó ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tó ní iye aláìsàn ikọ́ ife tó pọ̀ jù.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abavela emhlabeni wonke baphothule ucwaningo ngesikhathi lapho izindlela zokuhlola i-genome zingakatholakali kabanzi emazweni anezibalo eziphezulu zeziguli ezinesifo sofuba.
Hausa: Masu bincike daga sassa daban-daban na duniya sun kammala binciken ne a daidai lokacin da har yanzu ba a cika samun hanyoyin gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado ba a ƙasashen da suka fi yawan majiyyata masu fama da cutar tarin fuka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši gi tšwa lefaseng ka bophara ba ile ba dira dinyakišišo ka nako yeo e lego gore mekgwa ya diteko tša ditšini ka botlalo e be e se ya hlwa e hwetšagala ka bophara ka dinageng tšeo di bego di na le palo ya godimodimo ya balwetši ba TB.
Amharic: ከአለም ዙሪያ የተውጣጡ ተመራማሪዎች ጥናቱን ያጠናቀቁት የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ መመርመሪያ ዘዴዎች ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው የሳንባ ነቀርሳ በሽተኞች ባሉባቸው አገሮች ውስጥ በስፋት እስካልተገኙበት ወቅት ድረስ ነው።

English: The researchers wanted to show just how many drug-resistant patients were not accurately diagnosed and treated adequately because the tests used in their countries were not accurate or comprehensive enough.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okulaga omuwendo gw’abalwadde abagumira eddagala abaali tebaakeberwa bulungi era ne batajjanjabwa bulungi olw'okuba nti okukebera okwakozesebwa mu mawanga gaabwe kwali tekutuuse bulungi oba nga tekumalaayo byonna bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà fẹ́ fi bí iye aláìṣàn aláìgbóògùn kò ṣe rí ìtúpalẹ̀ àìsàn àti ìtọ́jú tó péye gbà nítorí àwọn àyẹ̀wò tí wọ́n lò ní orílẹ̀ èdè wọn kò ṣe rẹ́gí tàbí tẹ̀wọ̀ tó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukukhombisa ukuthi zingaki iziguli ezingazweli emishanguzweni ezingatholakalanga ngokunembile futhi zelashwe ngendlela efanele ngenxa yokuthi ukuhlola okusetshenziswa emazweni azo kwakunganembile noma kungaphelele ngokwanele.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun so su nuna adadin majinyata masu jure wa magani da ba a tantance su daidai da kuma yi musu magani yadda ya kamata ba saboda gwaje-gwajen da aka yi amfani da su a ƙasashensu ba su da inganci ko kuma ba cikakku ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go laetša gore ke balwetši ba bakae ba TB ya go palela dihlare bao ba sego ba phekolwa ka maleba le go alafša ka maleba ka ge diteko tšeo di šomišitšwego ka dinageng tša bona di be di se tša nepagala goba di sa kwešišege ka botlalo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በአገሮቻቸው ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ የዋሉት ምርመራዎች ትክክለኛ ወይም በበቂ ሁኔታ የተሟሉ ስላልሆኑ ምን ያህል መድኃኒት-የተላመዱ ታካሚዎች በትክክል ያልተመረመሩ እና ተገቢው ህክምና እንዳልተደረገላቸው ለማሳየት ይፈልጋሉ።

English: They took another look at samples previously obtained from 582 TB patients from seven countries who all have high numbers of TB cases:
Luganda: Era baatunuulira sampolo endala ezaggyibwa ku balwadde ba TB emabegako okuva mu mawanga musanvu era ng’amawanga ago gonna galina emiwendo gy’abalwadde ba TB minene:
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún wo àwọn àpẹẹrẹ àtẹ̀yìnwá tí wọ́n gbà láti ọ̀dọ àwọn aláìsàn TB 582 láti orílẹ̀ èdè méje tí gbogbo wọ́n ní ọ̀pọ ẹ̀sun TB:
Zulu: Baphinde babheka amasampula atholwe ngaphambilini ezigulini ze-TB ezingama-582 ezivela emazweni ayisikhombisa wonke anezibalo eziphezulu zabantu abane-TB:
Hausa: Sun sake duba samfurorin da aka samu a baya daga masu TB guda 582 daga ƙasashe bakwai waɗanda dukkansu suna da adadin masu cutar TB da dama:
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lebelela disampole gape tšeo mo nakong ye e fetilego di hweditšwego go balwetši ba TB ba 582 go tšwa ka dinageng tše šupa tšeo ka moka ga tšona di nago le dipalo tša godimo tša balwetši ba TB:
Amharic: ከዚህ በፊት በተሰበሰቡ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው የቲቢ ኬዞች ካለባቸው ሰባት ሀገራት የመጡ 582 የቲቢ ሕሙማን ናሙናዎች ላይ ሌላ እይታን አድርገዋል፦

English: Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa (all in Africa), Peru (in South America) and Thailand (in Asia).
Luganda: Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria ne South Afirika (gonna gano gali mu Afirika), Peru (mu South Amerika) ne Thailand (mu Asia).
Yoruba: Cote d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Nigeria àti South Africa (gbogbo wọ́n wà ní Áfíríkà), Peru (ní South America) àti Thailand (ní Asia)
Zulu: E-Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria kanye neNingizimu Afrika (zonke e-Afrika), Peru (eNingizimu Melika) kanye ne-Thailand (e-Asia).
Hausa: Cote d'Ivoire da Jamhuriyar Demokraɗiyyar Kongo da Kenya, Nijeriya da Afirka ta Kudu (duk a Afirka) da Peru (a Kudancin Amurka) da kuma Thailand (a Asiya).
Northern Sotho: Côte d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Nigeria le Afrika Borwa (ka moka ka Afrika), Peru (ka Borwa bja Amerika) le Thailand (ka Asia).
Amharic: ኮትዲቫር፣ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ፣ ኬንያ፣ ናይጄሪያ እና ደቡብ አፍሪካ (ሁሉም በአፍሪካ)፣ ፔሩ (በደቡብ አሜሪካ) እና ታይላንድ (በእስያ)።

English: The patients all also had HIV.
Luganda: Abalwadde abo bonna era baalina HIV.
Yoruba: Gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn náà ló ní HIV.
Zulu: Iziguli zonke bezinane-HIV.
Hausa: Haka nan majiyyatan duk suna da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši gape ba be ba na le HIV.
Amharic: ሁሉም ታማሚዎች ኤችአይቪም ነበረባቸው።

English: The researchers already knew the results of the drug-susceptibility tests that were previously done using these samples.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baali bamanyi ebyava mu kukebera eddagala obutakola ku bulwadde okwakolebwa emabegako nga bakozesa sampolo ezo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà ti mo èsi àwọn àyẹ̀wo ògun-abárùnagbègbèjà tí wọ́n ṣe tẹ́lẹ̀ pẹ̀lú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi base beyazi imiphumela yokuhlolwa kokungazweli emishanguzweni okwakwenziwe ngaphambilini kusetshenziswa la masampula.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun riga sun san sakamakon gwaje-gwajen karɓuwar magani da aka yi amfani da su a baya ta hanyar amfani da waɗannan samfurori.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba šetše ba tseba dipoelo tša diteko tša go palelwa ga diokobatši tšeo di dirilwego mo nakong ye e fetilego go šomišwa disampole tše.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ቀደም ሲል እነዚህን ናሙናዎች በመጠቀም የተደረጉትን የመድኃኒት-ተጋላጭነት ምርመራ ውጤቶችን አስቀድመው ያውቁ ነበር።

English: The samples were then retested using whole genome testing methods in laboratories in Switzerland and the United States of America.
Luganda: Sampolo ezo era zaakeberwa nga bakozesa obukodyo bw’okukebera endagabutonde mu bulamba mu makeberero g’e Switzerland ne Amerika.
Yoruba: Àwọn àpẹẹrẹ náà di títúnyẹ̀wò nípa lílo ìlànà àyẹ̀wo gbogbo àpo jíìnì inú láàbù ní Switzerland àti United States of America.
Zulu: Amasampula abe esehlolwa kabusha kusetshenziswa izindlela zokuhlola i-genome eziphelele ezindaweni zokucwaninga e-Switzerland nase-United States of America.
Hausa: Sannan an sake gwada samfurorin ta amfani da hanyoyin gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado a ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje a ƙasashen Switzerland da kuma Amurka.
Northern Sotho: Disampole di ile tša dirwa diteko gape go šomišwa mekgwa ya teko ya ditšini ka botlalo ka dilaporathoring ka Switzerland le ka United States of America.
Amharic: ናሙናዎቹ በስዊዘርላንድ እና በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኦፍ አሜሪካ በሚገኙ ቤተ-ሙከራዎች ውስጥ አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ ምርመራ ዘዴዎችን በመጠቀም እንደገና ተመርምረዋል።

English: The researchers then compared the results of the two types of tests.
Luganda: Olwo ate abanoonyereza ne bageraageranya ebyava mu kukebera okw’emirundi ebiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà wá ṣe ìfiwéra èsì àyẹ̀wò oríṣìí méjéèjì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babe sebeqhathanisa imiphumela yezinhlobo ezimbili zokuhlolwa.
Hausa: Sannan masu binciken sun kwatanta sakamakon gwaje-gwajen nau'ikan biyu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši go tloga fao ba ile ba bapetša dipoelo tša mehuta ye mebedi ya diteko.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የሁለቱ አይነት ምርመራ ውጤቶችን አነጻጽረዋል።

English: They found that the drug-susceptibility tests did not correctly pick up that 130 (22%) of the 582 patients indeed had drug-resistant TB.
Luganda: Baazuula nti okukebera eddagala obutakola ku bulwadde tekwalengera nti ddala abalwadde 130 (22%) ku balwadde 582 ddala baalina TB agumira eddagala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé àyẹ̀wo ògun-abárùnagbègbèjà kò wà ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú 130 (22%) nínú iye aláìsàn 582 tó ní aláìgbóògùn TB.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ukuhlolwa kokungazweli emishanguzweni akuzange kubonise ukuthi iziguli ezili-130 (22%) kwezingama-582 zine-TB engazweli emishanguzweni.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa gwaje-gwajen karɓuwar magani ba su ɗauka daidai ba cewa 130 (22%) na marasa lafiya guda 582 suna da TB mai jure wa magani ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utolla gore diteko tša go palelwa ga diokobatši ga se tša kgona go tseba gore ba 130 (22%) ba balwetši ba 582 ka nnete ba be ba na le TB ya go palela diokobatši.
Amharic: በመድኃኒት-ተጋላጭነት ምርመራ ከ582 ታካሚዎች ውስጥ 130ቱ (22%) በእርግጥ መድኃኒት-የተላመደ ቲቢ እንዳለባቸው በትክክል እንዳላረጋገጡ ደርሰውበታል።

English: In the process, around 15% of patients did not receive the right treatment.
Luganda: Mu kukola batyo, abalwadde nga 15% tebaafuna bujjanjabi butuufu.
Yoruba: Nínú ìlànà náà, bí i 15% àwọn aláìsàn náà ni kò rí ìtọ́jú tó yẹ.
Zulu: Ngaleso sikhathi, cishe i-15% weziguli azizange zikuthole ukwelashwa okufanele.
Hausa: A cikin tsarin, kusan kashi 15% na majiyyatan ba su sami magani mai kyau ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka tshepedišong ye, palo ye e ka bago 15% ya balwetši ga se ya hwetša kalafo ya maleba.
Amharic: በሂደቱ፣ 15% የሚሆኑት ታካሚዎች ትክክለኛውን ህክምና አላገኙም።

English: This happened for patients in all seven countries.
Luganda: Kino kyatuuka ku balwadde bonna mu mawanga omusanvu.
Yoruba: Èyí ṣẹlẹ̀ fún àwọn aláìsàn ní gbogbo àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè méje náà.
Zulu: Lokhu kwenzeka ezigulini kuwo wonke amazwe ayisikhombisa.
Hausa: Wannan ya faru ga majiyyata a duk ƙasashen bakwai.
Northern Sotho: Se se diregile go balwetši ka dinageng tše šupa ka moka.
Amharic: ይህ የሆነው በሰባቱም ሀገራት ውስጥ ባሉ ታካሚዎች ነው።

English: They then looked at the results of only 530 of the patients.
Luganda: Ate ne batunuulira ebyavaamu ku balwadde 530 bokka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá wo èsì aláìsàn 530 péré.
Zulu: Babe sebebheka imiphumela yeziguli ezingama-530 kuphela.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka duba sakamakon guda 530 kawai na majiyyatan.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba lebelela dipoelo tša balwetši ba 530 fela.
Amharic: ከዚያም የ530 ታካሚዎችን ውጤቶች ብቻ ተመልክተዋል።

English: Of these, 63 (12%) died and 77 (15%) did not receive the right treatment.
Luganda: Ku abo, 63 (12%) baafa ne 77 (15%) tebaafuna bujjanjabi butuufu.
Yoruba: Nínú wọn, 63 (12%) ló kú bẹ́ẹ̀ 77 (15%) kò gba ìtọ́jú tó tọ́.
Zulu: Kulaba, abangama-63 (12%) bashonile kwathi abangama-77 (15%) abakutholanga ukwelashwa okufanele.
Hausa: Daga cikin waɗannan, guda 63 (12%) sun mutu, kuma guda 77 (15%) ba su sami maganin da ya dace ba.
Northern Sotho: Go bona, ba 63 (12%) ba hlokofetše gomme ba 77 (15%) ga se ba hwetša kalafo ya maleba.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ውስጥ፣ 63 (12%) ሞተዋል እና 77 (15%) ትክክለኛ ህክምና አላገኙም።

English: As shown in other studies, whole genome testing is by far a better way to control tuberculosis in general, and drug-resistant TB specifically.
Luganda: Era nga bwe kiragibwa mu kunoonyereza okulalala, okukebera endagabutonde okulamba y’engeri ekyasinze okutangira akafuba okutwaliza awamu, ate naddala TB agumira eddagala.
Yoruba: Bí ó ti wà nínú àwọn ìmọ̀ mìíràn, gbogbo àyẹ̀wò àpo jíìnì jẹ́ ọ̀nà tó dára láti ṣe ìṣàkóso ikọ́ ife lápapọ̀, àti TB aláìgbóògùn ní pàtó.
Zulu: Njengoba kuveziwe kwezinye izincwaningo, ukuhlola i-genome yonke kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokulawula isifo sofuba ngokujwayelekile, kanye ne-TB engazweli emishanguzweni ngokukhethekile.
Hausa: Kamar yadda aka nuna a wasu nazarin, gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado shi ya fi kyau wajen magance cutar tarin fuka gabaɗaya, musamman TB mai jure wa magani.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge go bontšhitšwe ka dinageng tše dingwe, teko ya ditšini ka botlalo go fihla mo lebakeng le ke tsela ye kaone ya go laola TB ka kakaretšo, le kudukudu TB ya go palela diokobatši.
Amharic: በሌሎች ጥናቶች እንደታየው፣ አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ ምርመራ በአጠቃላይ የሳንባ ነቀርሳን ለመቆጣጠር፣ እና በተለይም መድሃኒት-የተላመደ ቲቢን ለመቆጣጠር በጣም የተሻለው መንገድ ነው።

English: The findings support the World Health Organization’s stance at the time that countries with high volumes of TB patients should have whole genome testing sites too.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa bino biwagira endowooza y’Ekitongole ky’Ensi Yonna eky’Ebyobulamu ekigamba nti amawanga agalina abalwadde ba TB abangi ddala galina okubeera n’ebifo ewakebererwa endagabutonde mu bulamba.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí náà kín ipò Àjọ tó ní Rísí Ọ̀rọ̀ Ìlera Lágbàáyé lẹ́yìn ní àsìkò tí àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè pẹ̀lú ọ̀pọ aláìsàn TB le ní ibùdó àyèwò gbogbo àpo jíìnì.
Zulu: Okutholakele kusekela isimo seNhlangano Yezempilo Yomhlaba ngaleso sikhathi sokuthi amazwe anenani eliphezulu leziguli ze-TB kufanele abe nezindawo zokuhlola i-genome ephelele.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya goyi bayan matakin Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya a lokacin da ya kamata ƙasashen da suke da yawan masu cutar TB su sami wuraren gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo di thekga maemo a Mokgatlo wa Maphelo wa Lefase ao a laetšago gore ka nako yeo dinaga tšeo di nago le balwetši ba banši ba TB go swanetše go dirwe diteko tša ditšini ka botlalo.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የቲቢ ሕመምተኞች ያሉባቸው አገሮች አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ መመርመሪያ ቦታዎች ሊኖራቸው ይገባል የሚለውን አቋም ይደግፋሉ።

English: It will ensure quicker and more accurate testing, and better treatment.
Luganda: Kino kijja kuyambako okukebera amangu ate mu butuufu, n’obujjanjabi obusingako obulungi.
Yoruba: Yóò mú kí àyèwó yá kó sì ṣe wẹ́kú, àti fún ìtọ́jú tó péye.
Zulu: Izoqinisekisa ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokunemba kakhudlwana, kanye nokwelashwa okungcono.
Hausa: Hakan zai tabbatar da gwaji mai sauri da inganci tare da kuma ingantaccen magani.
Northern Sotho: Se se tla netefatša gore go ba le teko ya ka pela le yeo e nepagetšego, le kalafo ye kaone.
Amharic: ፈጣን እና ትክክለኛ ምርመራ፣ እና የተሻለ ህክምናን ያረጋግጣል።

English: A possible weakness of the study was that the samples of patients did not only have tuberculosis but were also HIV positive.
Luganda: Obunafu obuyinza okuba okuba nga bwe bwali mu kunoonyereza kuno bwe buno nti sampolo z’abalwadde tezaalimu bubeezi kafuba wabula era zaalimu ne HIV.
Yoruba: Àìṣedédé ìwádìí náà ni pé àwọn àpẹẹrẹ àwọn aláìsàn kò ní ikọ́ ife nìkan wọ́n ní àrun HIV pẹ̀lú.
Zulu: Ubuthakathaka obungase bube khona kulolu cwaningo ukuthi amasampula eziguli awazange abe nesifo sofuba kuphela kodwa futhi zazine-HIV.
Hausa: Wani rauni mai yiwuwa na binciken shi ne samfurorin marasa lafiya ba kawai suna da tarin fuka ba ne amma har ma ɗauke da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Kgonagalo ya bofokodi bja dinyakišišo e bile gore disampole tša balwetši ga se tša ba le TB eupša di be di na le HIV.
Amharic: የጥናቱ ድክመት ሊሆን የሚችለው የታካሚዎች ናሙናዎች የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ብቻ ሳይሆን ኤችአይቪ ያለባቸው መሆናቸው ነው።

English: After the study was done between 2013 and 2016, more drug-resistant tests already became available.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza bwe kwamala okukolebwa wakati wa 2013 ne 2016, okukebera kw’okulaba okugumira eddagala kwatandika okulabika.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn tí ìwádìí náà di ṣíṣe láàárín 2013 àti 2016, ọ̀pọ àyẹ̀wo aláìgbóògùn ti gbòde.
Zulu: Ngemva kokuthi ucwaningo selenziwe phakathi kuwezi-2013 nowezi-2016, ukuhlola okwengeziwe kokumelana nezidakamizwa kwase kutholakala.
Hausa: Bayan da aka yi binciken a tsakanin shekarun 2013 da 2016, an riga an sami ƙarin gwaje-gwaje masu jure wa magani.
Northern Sotho: Ka morago ga ge dinyakišišo di dirilwe magareng ga 2013 le 2016, diteko tše dingwe tša go palelwa ga diokobatši di be di šetše di hwetšagala.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በ 2013 እና 2016 መካከል ከተካሄደ በኋላ፣ ብዙ መድኃኒት-የተላመዱ ምርመራዎች አስቀድመው ተገኝተዋል።

English: The lives of many more TB patients can be saved in Africa and other poorer regions of the world by building whole genome testing sites in these countries.
Luganda: Kale nno obulamu bw’abalwadde ba TB bungi mu Afirika busobola okutaasibwa wamu n’ebitundu by’ensi ebirala ebyavu nga kikolebwa na kuzimba bifo ewakebererwa endagabutonde mu bulamba mu mawanga ago.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀mí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn TB lè di yíyè ní Áfíríkà àti àwọn agbègbè tí ò ní nǹkookan lágbàáyé nípa kíkọ́ ibùdó àyẹ̀wò àpo jíìnì ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Izimpilo zeziguli eziningi ze-TB zingasindiswa e-Afrika nakwezinye izifunda ezimpofu kakhulu emhlabeni ngokwakha izindawo zokuhlola i-genome eziphelele kulawa mazwe.
Hausa: Za a iya ceton rayukan masu cutar TB da yawa a Afirka da sauran yankuna masu fama da talauci ta hanyar gina wuraren gwajin ilahirin ƙwayoyin gado a waɗannan ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Maphelo a balwetši ba bangwe ba TB ba bantši a ka phološwa ka Afrika le ka dileteng tše dingwe tša go itlhokela tša lefase ka go aga mafelo a go dira diteko tša ditšini ka botlalo ka mo dinageng tše.
Amharic: በእነዚህ አገሮች አጠቃላይ የተሟላ የአንድ አካል የዘረመል መረጃ መመርመሪያ ቦታዎችን በመገንባት የብዙ ቲቢ ሕሙማንን ሕይወት በአፍሪካና በሌሎች ድሃ በሆኑ የዓለም አካባቢዎች ማዳን ይቻላል።

English: Governments should therefore invest in such facilities.
Luganda: Kale nno gavumenti zirina okusiga ensimbi mu bintu bwe bityo ebiyamba.
Yoruba: Ìjọbá gbọ́dọ̀ náwó sí àwọn ohun ìlò wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke ohulumeni kufanele batshale imali kulezi zikhungo.
Hausa: Don haka, yakamata gwamnatoci su saka hannun jari a irin waɗannan wuraren.
Northern Sotho: Mebušo ka fao e swanetše go beeletša ka mo mafelong a mohuta woo.
Amharic: ስለዚህ መንግስታት እንደዚህ ባሉ መገልገያዎች ላይ መዋዕለ ንዋይ ፈሰስ ማድረግ አለባቸው።

English: It will help local doctors to accurately diagnose whether a patient has drug-resistant TB or not, and to therefore prescribe the right treatment for individual patients.
Luganda: Kino kijja kuyamba abasawo b’omu mawanga ago okukebera mu butuufu okulaba oba ng’abalwadde balina TB agumira eddagala oba nedda, bwe batyo bawe abalwadde kinnoomu obujjanjabi obutuufu.
Yoruba: Yóò ran àwọn dókìtà abẹ́lé lọ́wọ́ láti ṣe ìtúpalẹ̀ àìsàn bóyá àìsàn aláìgbóògùn TB ni aláìsán ní ni tàbí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, wọ́n yóò si kògùn tó t́ fún irúfẹ́ aláìsàn bẹ́ẹ̀.
Zulu: Kuzosiza odokotela bendawo ukuthi bahlonze ngokunembile ukuthi isiguli sine-TB engazweli emishanguzweni noma cha, futhi ngenxa yalokho banqumele isiguli ukwelashwa okufanele.
Hausa: Zai taimaka wa likitocin gida su tantance daidai ko majiyyaci yana da TB mai jure wa magani ko a’a, don haka, su bayar da maganin da ya dace ga kowane majiyyaci.
Northern Sotho: Se se tla thuša dingaka tša tikologo go phekola ka fao go nepagetšego ge eba molwetši o na le TB ya go palela diokobatši goba aowa, le go fa balwetši ka bobona kalafo ya maleba.
Amharic: በአካባቢው ያሉ ዶክተሮች አንድ ታካሚ መድኃኒት-የተላመደ ቲቢ እንዳለበት ወይም እንደሌለው በትክክል ለመመርመር ይረዳል፣ እና ስለዚህ ለእያንዳንዳቸው ታካሚዎች ትክክለኛውን ህክምና ለማዘዝ ይረዳል።
